why: THE RECON APPLIED, WITH NO TWO-CARD INFINITES by the pilot's call (deck_recon.json, 2026-09-10, EDHREC's 3,924 pair decks). The Curiosity-class enchantments the pair is usually built around are deliberately OUT: with Niv-Mizzet Parun and Glint-Horn Buccaneer they are two-card loops. In their place the combo-free recon cards: Whirlwind of Thought, Magmakin Artillerist, Surly Badgersaur, beside Ojer Axonil as the amplifier. Interaction 4 -> 12 (Swords, Path, Counterspell, Veto, Arcane Denial, Blasphemous Act, Chaos Warp, Rift, Boros Charm, Teferi's Protection). Seven surplus wheels and the Puzzle Box out for the loot suite (Frantic Search, Thrill, Cathartic Reunion, Brainstorm); eight wheels stay. The builder's 17 off-map picks out for the discard payoffs (Captain Howler, Marauding Mako, Ghostly Pilferer), Teferi's Ageless Insight, Thought Vessel and three two-mana rocks. Its twelve coverage-chosen lands out for the cycling-land package; 35 lands. Bracket 4 by Game Changer count only. THE GOLDFISH READS THE SHARK HALF: Brallin's discard trigger has no channel and a wheel's 'draws that many' is not 'draw N', so the draw axis is a proxy. Forge at standard-v3 is the verdict.
